evidence.title: Badenoch's £10bn air defence plan points to growing concern over protecting UK's skies

occurrences.checkable_against: Records of drone and missile attacks against Israel and the UK
occurrences.quote_span: Israel has regularly been targeted by drones and missiles over the past decade. The UK has not.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: Conservative Party original air-defence press release
occurrences.quote_span: Their original press release mentioned building a new air defence systems that would be "in essence, a British Iron Dome", referencing Israel's elaborate air defence system.
occurrences.speaker: Conservative Party
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: UK Ministry of Defence air-defence system inventory
occurrences.quote_span: Currently the country has a number of systems to deal with short and medium-range threats – from drones to cruise missiles.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: Official geographic area measurements for Israel and the United Kingdom
occurrences.quote_span: But any comparison of the challenge of defending Britain's skies with Israel's, about 10% the size of the UK, is naive.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: Conservative Party clarification of its air-defence policy
occurrences.quote_span: The Conservatives now suggest the phrase "Iron Dome" was just a shorthand for better air defences.
occurrences.speaker: Conservative Party
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: UK Ministry of Defence inventory of systems protecting strategic sites
occurrences.quote_span: At present the UK doesn't even have that.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: Israel annual defence budget and air-defence expenditure records
occurrences.quote_span: Israel also spends a significant proportion of its $45bn (£33.9bn) annual military budget on air defences.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: Conservative Party air-defence policy announcement
occurrences.quote_span: The Conservatives now say they will spend more - £10 bn - over a decade.
occurrences.speaker: Conservative Party
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: UK armed forces weapons-system inventory and capability assessments
occurrences.quote_span: But the armed forces still lack a weapons system to deal with long-range ballistic and hypersonic missiles.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: Ukraine air-defence performance assessments and records of large-scale attacks
occurrences.quote_span: Russia's war in Ukraine has also exposed the huge challenge of defending their own skies from large-scale attacks.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: US Patriot missile system procurement contracts and unit-cost records
occurrences.quote_span: Each interceptor used by the US Patriot missile system costs about $4m (£3m).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan

occurrences.checkable_against: Published Conservative and Labour air-defence policy statements
occurrences.quote_span: Both parties agree that the UK needs layers of air defences.

occurrences.subject: Conservative Party UK air defence spending plan
